title: Country Law Repo API
text: For a US Client (Private project and not accessible publicly)
description: An API service that powers the Admin Portal for US clients. It centralizes and manages data related to patents, trademarks, and other intellectual property. The API processes requests, applications, official fees, and jurisdiction-specific rules to support individuals or organizations applying for IP protection in different countries. Built with .NET Core and Entity Framework for secure, scalable, and structured access to legal content.

title: Admin Portal
text: For a US Client (Private project and not accessible publicly)
description: A management portal built for US clients to oversee and process intellectual property information such as patents, trademarks, and design filings. The portal interacts with the Country Law Repo API to handle applications, fee calculations, jurisdiction rules, and workflow processing. Designed to streamline operations for IP administrators handling country-specific regulations and submissions.

title: Unient

title: PPSTA
text: Philippine Public School Teachers Association - Insurance System
description: The Philippine Public School Teachers Association (PPSTA) is the largest and leading professional organization for public school educators in the Philippines. It represents over 200,000 members nationwide, including administrators, supervisors, teachers, and non-teaching personnel working under the Department of Education.
